verdict.rationale: LiveKit is a platform for building AI agents, so letting its agents consume tools from MCP servers is a fair question to ask. The pack has no evidence that LiveKit agents can connect to external MCP servers. The Docs MCP item is LiveKit serving its own documentation to coding agents (server side), and Agent Builder's 'tool configuration' is a related feature that never mentions MCP; neither is credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
